description: A data-savvy team passionate about climate and desires to reduce the burden for future climatologists to study coding.
summary: Earthereal is a data analysis user interface that allows beginning climatologists to navigate atmospheric and oceanic NASA data. One can specify the location via longitude and latitude and the time period, as well as specific data of interest like atmospheric pressure, total precipitation, air temperature, etc. By selecting at least one form of data, they can generate graphs. Earthereal also comes with a science assistant that can help them process their data.
details:
Earthereal provides a list of atmospheric and oceanic variables that one can select in order to analyze the weather and climate in a specific region and timeframe, which they can specify as well.

The variables include:

  • Aerosols
  • Atmospheric pressure
  • Geopotential height
  • Air temperature
  • Precipitation

One can also specify their region of interest via a longitude and latitude range and time period in units of months, as well as the significance level value they wish with 0.05 as the largest.

To begin analyzing data, all they need is at least one variable, the geographic range, and time period of interest. Once they are all specified, they can generate graphs. Earthereal also comes with a science AI assistant in order to assist them with their data analysis.
